audit_name: CloudNotes Automated Vulnerability & Dependency CVE Audit
environment: CI/CD Security Scanner (pip-audit v2.7.0 + Trivy v0.48.0)

vulnerabilities.description: Werkzeug parsed large multipart form-data requests slowly, creating potential resource exhaustion under malicious input streams.
vulnerabilities.mitigation: CloudNotes configures app.config['MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH'] = 5 * 1024 * 1024 (5MB), capping incoming multipart payload size before Werkzeug parsing, neutralising the exhaustion vector. Upgrading to Werkzeug >= 3.0.1 scheduled in next maintenance sprint.

container_image_scan.triage_summary: All OS packages up to date via apt-get upgrade during image build; no unpatched exploitable CVEs.

conclusion.finding: Zero Critical or High severity CVEs detected. Medium vulnerability triaged and mitigated via application-level upload bounds.

limits: Audit represents point-in-time snapshot of dependencies on 2026-10-08; continuous scanning is required in CI pipeline for ongoing zero-day disclosures.
